notes.title: Game controller support (beta)
notes.content:
[b]Update KP009240: Improvements and fixes.[/b]

This update includes various improvements. Key changes include:

- Provides a software support for game controllers (beta)

Starting with this version you may use a game controller both for moving your progressbar (left joystick by default) and your cursor (right joystick), click joystick to make a mouse click. 'Driver' is a beta form since some bugs and glitches may occur (please report any issues in the community)

Mapping:

[b]Right stick[/b] - move Cursor
[b]Left stick[/b] - move progressbar
[b]D-Pad[/b] - move progressbar (in selected game modes)
[b]D-Pad[/b] - change selection (in some menus)
[b](A)[/b] - select item
[b](B)[/b] - activate Begin menu
[b][LB],[RB][/b] - previous/next menu in Progress Shell


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38605237/5e8c25f7a683b5a8dd19390bdb105a80fae12b83.png[/img]
